name: makeNewSale
intent: Start a new sale at the current cash desk.
pre: A current cash desk is selected.
The current cash desk is open.
There is no current sale, or the current sale is complete.
post: Link the new sale to the current cash desk.
Add the new sale to the current cash desk's sales.
Mark the new sale as incomplete.
Mark the new sale as not ready for payment.
Store the new sale among the system's sales.
Make the new sale the current sale.
difficulty_basis: Disjunctive workflow guard, new object, two-way association and session binding.
scenarios: Current sale, both desk links, two flags, stored membership and true result checked. Prior completed-sale branch is untested.
effects_audit: No zero-total initialization, current-store guard or invented sale ID requirement.

name: enterItem
intent: Add a sales line for the selected item to the current sale and reduce its stock.
pre: An item with the supplied barcode exists.
The selected item's stock quantity is greater than zero.
post: Create a new sales line item.
Make the new sales line the current sale line.
Link the new sales line to the current sale.
Add the new sales line to the current sale's lines.
Set the new line's quantity to quantity.
Link the new line to the selected item.
Reduce the item's stock quantity by quantity relative to its stock before this operation.
Set the line subtotal to the item's price multiplied by quantity.
Store the new line among the system's sales line items.
difficulty_basis: New line, multi-object associations, stock arithmetic and session state.
scenarios: All listed effects checked with stock 2 to 1 and subtotal 3.5.
effects_audit: Source guards only stock > 0, not stock >= quantity; no positive-quantity or no-overselling guard added.

name: endSale
intent: Make the current sale ready for payment and report its resulting amount.
pre: The current sale is not yet ready for payment.
post: Mark the current sale as ready for payment.
Return the sale amount after this operation.
missing: Original subtotal aggregation specification must resolve Set(Real) declaration versus collected line subtotals, especially equal subtotals on different lines. Jest only uses distinct 1, 2, 3. Exact amount-calculation obligation is withheld.
scenarios: Ready-to-pay and returning updated amount agree; sum 6 does not establish duplicate-value semantics.
effects_audit: No completion flag change or payment creation inferred. Amount assignment exists but precise aggregate semantics remain pending.

name: makeCashPayment
intent: Record a cash payment for the current sale and complete the sale.
pre: The current sale is ready for payment.
The supplied amount is at least the current sale's amount.
post: Record amount as the payment's tendered amount.
Link the payment to the current sale.
Set the current sale's associated payment to the new payment.
Link the current sale to the current store.
Add the current sale to the current store's sales.
Mark the current sale as complete.
Record the current time as the sale time.
Set the payment balance to amount minus the current sale amount.
Store the new payment among cash payments.
missing: Original workflow/operation specification must establish CurrentStore availability: reference postcondition updates CurrentStore.Sales but its precondition does not require a current store. Jest initializes it. No guard was inferred from this setup.
scenarios: Tendered 2 against amount 1 gives balance 1; links, completion, stored payment and current time checked under initialized store.
effects_audit: All explicit payment/store/sale effects restored. No current-store guard or extra sale amount/frame guarantee added.
